title: Unable to return to meshtastic firmware
body:
Hi,
After flashing meshcore firmware on T1000-e, playing around I have decided to move back to the default meshtastic firmware. Unfortunately I am unable to do so.

1. "Custom" firmware from the flasher - timeouts
2. Flasher -> T1000e -> enter DFU -> back -> custom firmware - timeouts
3. `meshtastic` python client fails as well with timeouts.

Currently, I can only re-flash the meshcore firmware, which is far from optimal.
Any advice would be greatly appreciated.
author: lukaszraczylo

comments.body: try to hold the power button and double-"click"(connect and disconnect quickly) the magnetic power/usb connector - that's how you can get into usb-mass storage mode. from there you can just copy over uf2 firmware file.

Perfect, that sorted the issue.

Ps. I hope to come back to the meshcore as a contributor when a few more devices arrive ( most likely within next few days ) :)

satisfaction_conditions: A working method to return to Meshtastic firmware from MeshCore firmware on the T1000-e device
A firmware flashing approach that bypasses the timeout issues experienced with other methods
A clear, step-by-step procedure that can be followed without specialized technical knowledge
A method that works with the existing hardware without requiring additional tools

_classification.category: Requires build environment but hard to be dockerized
